episode_title: Så undviker du Aktiefusk på börsen - Sparpodden 429
summary: Educational episode about stock fraud and market manipulation featuring guests from Ekobrottsmyndigheten (Swedish Economic Crime Authority). Jan Leopoldsson and Jonas Myrdal explain common types of market manipulation like 'enpetare' and 'layering', discuss the MAR regulation, and provide guidance on how to stay on the right side of the law when trading stocks. No stock recommendations were given.
key_takeaways: Never attempt to manipulate the stock price through trading or information spread
All transactions should have a commercial purpose - buy because you want to own the stock
Posting positive views about stocks on forums is legal, but must be genuine and not intended to manipulate
MAR regulation sets rules for market manipulation, insider trading, and company information disclosure
Market manipulation can result in fines of 70-130,000 SEK for minor offenses
Be critical of one-sided positive information on social media - look for both bull and bear cases
